en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a small European town in a valley with gently rolling hills in the background. In the center stands a prominent church with a tall, layered tower and spire. Surrounding it are residential houses with pitched roofs, some larger villa‑style buildings, and what appear to be industrial chimneys. Trees and gardens fill the foreground. At the bottom in red Gothic-style script is the caption "Gruß aus Kreischa." On the left margin appears a small vertical printer's credit.
